# Actual connected harness source fixture

37 exact Git source bodies from LOCAL harness commit
`73ab11883bb1c8924dc5ebbe8a61c96e913ee437`, tree
`58a0ef9827c5445479258a2af06a06f6b5519d13`. This dependency is not asserted public.
`provenance.json` binds every original path, target and SHA256. `.ts.txt` keeps native Node test discovery
from treating vendored source as a package. No manually rewritten success-shaped writer is substituted.

`test/dashboard-host-fixture.ts` verifies every source digest, transpiles the actual source with retained
TypeScript and changes ONLY package-core import specifiers to the actual pinned core re-export module.
The pinned generated P01/retention validators remain unchanged. Typebox resolves through the actual retained
package peer, not a guessed checkout dependency or weakened schema. No package manager/build lifecycle runs.

It inventories actual compiled bytes, then calls the PRODUCT `loadDashboardHarness` to verify and stage
them into an exclusive fresh module tree and load genuine callable ports. Ordinary host/controller tests
then execute actual journal/CAS/registration, archive/checkpoint/signal readers, trust reservations and
case/blind decision writers. Faults target actual required filesystem acknowledgements; no fake success.
Original debrief pins/fixtures remain unchanged and retain their old compatibility coverage.

These are synthetic authorities/declarations and model-free processes exercising real implementations.
They do not establish human/module authentication, real daily labels, calibrated efficacy, deployed
privacy consent, live atomic TUI pause, source completeness or overall factory acceptance.
